name: IEMOCAP six-class TRIM extension
selection: global Session 4 full-input Macro-F1; earliest epoch on exact tie
text: raw transcripts, pinned bert_en vocab, BertTokenizer lower-case, CLS; four supplied text feature dictionaries unused
av_preprocessing: per-dimension z-score fitted on observed Session 1-3 rows only; std clamped at 1e-6; native all-zero rows remain zero and explicitly absent

auxiliary.masked_pairs: legacy batch objectives retained for all four multimodal systems

interventions.donors: label-independent bijections shared across models/seeds; native missing masks travel with donor

emap.secondary: each bank and each half-anchor projection
emap.not_measured: A-V interaction internal to paired AV

bootstrap.scope: pointwise intervals conditional on Session 5 and its two speakers; no population speaker-generalization inference

reporting.primary: Macro-F1 mean and sample SD across five seeds
reporting.feature_provenance: AV extractor training history not independently verified
reporting.protocol_scope: single fixed session holdout; not five-fold IEMOCAP SOTA comparison
